blocks.text: The Agentic Security Operations Platform (Agentic SecOps Platform) uses measurements and dimensions to organize and analyze data in reports, dashboards, and saved views. A dashboard or report is configured by selecting one or more dimensions and a measurement. The dimension defines how data is grouped (e.g., by user, tenant, or severity, etc.) and the measurement defines the value to be calculated and displayed (e.g., count of alerts, number of users, or risk score, etc.).

Dimensions are grouped by Main Entity (e.g., Ticket, Asset, etc.), and based on the selected dimension, the measurement list appears. For example, if Ticket is selected for Main Entity, only fields associated with tickets are included.
In measurement and dimension lists, you can perform the following actions:

blocks.item: Click the Measurements icon to view the list of available measurements.
Click the Dimensions icon to view the list of available dimensions.
Click In Use to display the fields currently in use.
Use the search bar to locate specific fields.

blocks.text: For example, if you want to create a dashboard widget that shows the number of alerts and status, you can do the following:

blocks.item: Select Total Alerts as the measurement to calculate the total number of alerts.
Select Alert Status as the dimension to group the alerts by status.

blocks.text: The widget displays the number of alerts with status. If you add users as another dimension, the widget groups the same measurement by both users and status, providing a more detailed view of alert distribution.
To learn more, see Configuring Custom Dashboards.
